entities.summary: Jan Lutek was a Polish diplomat and clergyman who played a pivotal role in the governance of Kraków during the late 15th century. He served as Bishop of Kraków from 1464 to 1471, overseeing various administrative tasks and contributing to the city's economic growth. Lutek's tenure was marked by significant cultural achievements, including the establishment of several schools and churches in the region. His diplomatic efforts also helped maintain peace between Poland and its neighboring countries. The legacy of Jan Lutek can be seen in the continued development of Kraków as a major hub for trade and commerce in Eastern Europe. Despite his passing in 1471, Lutek's contributions to Polish history remain an important aspect of the country's cultural heritage.
